claim: With standard colours the build's outline stays on and an 'Outline off' toggle removes it; with the painted (Enhanced) sprite set the outline is off, and that set excludes the toggle.

evidence.text: Standard colours: black outline on, toggle 'Outline off'. Painted (Enhanced): none, and it excludes that toggle.
Owner: outline off with painted sprites; on with the standard ones, with a way to turn it off or black; outline on per the owner's standing preference.
